properties.description: The portico, which was built in the ionic order (1st century AD) belonging to the civic agora next to the colonnaded street, was collapsed into the pool formed in the fracture caused by an earthquake in the 7th c AD
properties.name: Antik Havuz
Traverten Yolu
properties.note: Path is a low slope rock face with lukewarm water running down it. In the winter, by the time the water reaches the bottom of the bath, it is freezing cold. Shoes must be removed or a different entrance to the top must be used.
